name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee
description: Bold moka brew meets silky condensed milk. Sweet, strong, unforgettable.
ingredients: About 100 ml water for moka pot (adjust to pot specifications)
Ice, to fill a 300 ml glass
steps: Brew a strong concentrate with your moka pot, following its safe fill guidelines.
Stir the hot coffee with condensed milk until completely smooth.
Add cold milk if you prefer a softer cup.
Pour over a full glass of ice and stir once.

name: Spanish Latte
description: A velvety iced latte with a delicate condensed-milk finish.
steps: Stir condensed milk into the warm coffee until dissolved.
Fill a glass with ice and chilled milk.
Pour the coffee slowly over the milk for a layered finish.
Adjust condensed milk to your preferred sweetness.

name: Jamun Coffee Tonic
description: Jamun fruit, bright citrus and sparkling tonic meet an espresso-style brew.
ingredients: 35–45 ml strong moka coffee, cooled slightly
Ice and a pinch of salt
steps: Muddle deseeded jamun with lime and a tiny pinch of salt.
Add plenty of ice and slowly pour in chilled tonic.
Gently float the coffee on top.
Taste before adding any sweetener; tonic may already be sweet.

name: Classic Cappuccino
description: Deep coffee, creamy steamed milk and a cloud of foam.
ingredients: 160–180 ml hot milk (adjust for cup size)
steps: Brew the coffee into a preheated cup.
Heat milk without letting it boil and froth until velvety.
Gently pour the milk and foam into the coffee.
Finish with latte art or a little cocoa if you like.

name: Iced Honey Latte
description: Floral honey, smooth milk and punchy coffee. Sweetness, kept in balance.
steps: Dissolve honey into freshly brewed warm coffee.
Add ice and chilled milk to a glass.
Pour the honey coffee over the milk.
Taste before adding extra honey.

name: Cranberry Coffee Fizz
description: Tart cranberry and bold coffee — bright, refreshing and a little unexpected.
ingredients: 60 ml plain chilled soda water, optional
steps: Fill a tall glass with plenty of ice.
Add cranberry juice and optional soda water.
Slowly pour cooled coffee over the top.
Finish with a small squeeze of lime if desired.

name: Iced Americano
steps: Brew your moka coffee and let it settle briefly.
Add chilled water and ice to a serving glass.
Pour the coffee over the top.
Adjust with water for your preferred intensity.

name: Lychee Coffee Fizz
description: Delicate lychee and lively bubbles with an aromatic coffee finish.
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
Add chilled lychee juice and soda water.
Float the coffee gently on top.
Taste before adding sweetener — bottled lychee juice is often sweet.
